title: DUAL
tagline: Dual is a social GameFi platform built on Filecoin. It empowers gamers to explore and trade NFTs by participating in dual battles. Dual also provides a platform for users to build gaming communities and monetize their skills through live streaming and video content
description:
This project enables gamers to upload their gaming NFT rewards to the platform, which are securely stored on the Filecoin network using web3.storage. Each gamer has a profile that showcases a comprehensive bio and other relevant information, allowing fellow gamers to gain insights into their background and capabilities, providing a better understanding of their opponents.

Gamers have the option to upload their gaming NFT collections onto the platform, engaging in dual battles with other gamers to trade these unique assets. The utilization of the ERC1155 token standard allows gamers to create exclusive limited edition collections, fostering a highly competitive environment for engaging in challenging battles. These NFTs hold significant value on our platform, extending beyond mere speculative investments.

When a gamer emerges victorious in a dual challenge, they can choose to either claim the NFT prize or retain it for potential future sales at a higher price. Our platform empowers gamer's to monetize their hard-earned NFTs while fostering connections with fellow gamer's, all within a social environment that enables them to build a dedicated audience.

Dual provides a platform for users to trade NFTs, build gaming communities, and monetize skills through live streaming and video content. Dual uses a decentralized storage network like Filecoin to securely and efficiently store user’s data.
how_its_made:
Smart Contract
- The project used the open zeppelin ERC1155 token standard to implement the collections. The contract handles the creation of every collection on the Dual platform.
- The smart contracts are deployed to the Filecoin blockchain(Calibration testnet).
- Video smart contract to store user data deployed to the Filecoin blockchain(Calibration testnet).

Decentralized Storage
- All Gamers content are saved on Filecoin storage using web3.storage to store and retrieve data.
- We also used Lighthouse to Store Video content data
- And used IPFS to retrieve the data 

The front-end
- We will be using ReactJS, Javascript, ethersJS and rainbow toolkit.
- Chakra-UI for styling   

Social Features
- We will be using Livepeer for Gamers to stream there game which also allows audience to view the Gamer's challenging each other.
- We also used Huddle01 for Gamer's to set up meetings for their arrangement.
- And we also used Push Protocol to send notification when new Collection are uploaded, Push Chat for Gamers to communicate with each other.

Will be add more features and more Protocols to this Project a great platform for Gaming
